integrity: The proof is exact. The bundled checker reconstructs the relevant degree-\(768\) polynomial and verifies its coefficient valuations using integer arithmetic. The 2013 and 2015 primary full texts were materially inspected. A residual originality risk remains for unindexed or differently phrased explicit examples. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The 2015 Czédli–Kunos theorem already proves existence of a two-integer nonconstructible cyclic \(n\)-gon for every odd \(n\ge8\). The present result does not strengthen that general theorem; it supplies one explicit \(n=771\) witness with consecutive integer lengths and an elementary \(769\)-adic certificate. No minimality or classification is claimed.
title: An explicit two-integer nonconstructible cyclic \(771\)-gon
